datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule for Burkina Faso in 2020. Geographic data representing food insecurity phases (IPC scenarios) were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for October, November, and December projections, capturing spatial variation in acute food insecurity across the country.
